meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你说要报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug 时，它会自动调查问题、找到根因，并在正确的 GitHub 仓库创建 issue 或 PR，附带重现步骤和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我报告一个 LazyCodex 安装器报错的 bug。
say.note: 它会自动调查并创建 issue。

say.text: 在 openai/codex 仓库提交一个 PR 修复这个 CLI 问题。

howto.what_en: When you ask to report a bug in LazyCodex or Codex CLI, it investigates, finds root cause, and creates a GitHub issue or PR in the correct repo with reproduction steps and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: Report a bug about LazyCodex installer error.
say_en.note: It will investigate and create an issue.

say_en.text: Create a PR in openai/codex to fix this CLI issue.
say_en.note: Only creates PR if bug reproduces in clean upstream Codex.
